critical_evidence.evidence: No borescope or cylinder-wall evidence is mentioned in the listing or comments. The March 2026 PPI report contents are not examined here. Not held against the car, but a 3.4 S at 83k has full bore-scoring exposure and nothing establishes cylinder 4-6 condition.
Seller says the last page of his March 2026 PPI report shows the over-rev scan. A commenter asked for a legible version. Not examined here; no ignition counts per range are stated.

No water pump, coolant pipe, AOS, spark plug/coil or clutch documentation is cited. The only work named is an ignition switch and O2 sensor (June 2026, per seller). Carfax lists 11 service records with no detail given.

documentation.rationale: Identity half is present: decode-matched VIN and a Carfax snapshot (4 owners, 2019 minor front damage, 11 records). The maintenance half is largely absent here. The PPI report, over-rev scan and receipt exist only as seller comments, not examined here. There are no cooling/AOS/clutch records, no borescope, and no install receipts for the mods. The title odometer is 'Exempt'.

condition.rationale: Observed: a cracked windshield and an undocumented 2019 front-damage event. Photos show tidy paint and interior from a distance with modest bolster wear. Nothing proves engine health on an M97 3.4 at 83k. Mechanical condition is otherwise unknown.

price_value.rationale: Fair value is $24.0k-$29.6k (mid $26.9k). A likely hammer in the low-to-mid $20ks would sit below mid. The discount is offset by a cracked windshield, an undocumented accident, extensive mods that narrow resale, and possible smog-compliance costs. Unknown engine condition on a 3.4 makes any discount risk-priced rather than value.

mission_fit.rationale: As a future keeper it is the higher-risk variant (3.4 S) with no borescope and no cooling/AOS history. It also carries tasteful-to-loud aftermarket modifications that conflict with the stock/records preference. A keeper purchase at this price also draws on cash during bridge-car mode.

logistics.rationale: Pflugerville, TX, a fly-and-drive distance from Carmel. The auction closes 2026-10-22, leaving roughly two days to arrange an independent specialist PPI. California registration hinges on CARB status of the plenum and exhaust and on whether headers or the tune are stock.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: The manual 3.4 S is the desirable drivetrain. Arctic Silver over black is common. The aftermarket wheels, Maxton aero, smoked taillights, wing extension, transparent cover, Kenwood unit and sub move it away from the originality a keeper buyer wants.

evidence.mission_note: As a future keeper this is the riskier 3.4 S, heavily modified and lacking engine due diligence and cooling/AOS records; it does not meet the profile's 'unusually strong engine due diligence' bar on current evidence. A keeper purchase now also competes with cash preservation while Jason is in bridge mode with only the RX at home.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a VIN-matched 2007 Cayman S six-speed with about 83k miles, a clean Texas title marked odometer-exempt, and a Carfax snapshot showing four prior owners and minor front damage in November 2019 without repair detail. Observed issues are a cracked windshield and an extensive aftermarket package, including an IPD plenum and Soul exhaust. The seller's reply about catted headers and a stock ECU leaves open whether the emissions hardware or tune is stock. The seller has posted a March 2026 PPI report and receipt in comments, but none are examined here, and another bidder reports the over-rev scan is not legible. Nothing addresses cylinder-wall condition on the M97 3.4, nor water pump, coolant pipes, AOS or clutch history. California smog feasibility is undetermined. Comparable 84-98k-mile S cars sold between $22.5k and $30.5k, against a fair-value band of $24.0k-$29.6k.
evidence.next_action: Before the 2026-10-22 close, ask the seller for the full-resolution over-rev scan, the complete PPI report and confirmation of header/cat/ECU status, and price a Porsche-specialist borescope PPI in the Austin area for tomorrow.
